properties.name: Gishwati-Mukura Buffer Zone
properties.description: Highly degraded buffer zone around Gishwati-Mukura National Park. Target for restoration.

properties.name: Nyungwe Core Zone
properties.description: Mature montane rainforest. High AGB but low carbon headroom — expect low LCRI despite high biomass.

properties.name: Akagera Eastern Degraded Edge
properties.description: Savanna/woodland transition zone on Akagera eastern boundary. Moderate degradation trend.

properties.name: Volcanoes NP Buffer
properties.description: Sub-montane forest buffer around Volcanoes National Park. Steep slopes limit planting feasibility.

properties.name: Bugesera Agroforestry Corridor
properties.description: Low-lying agricultural zone with scattered woodlots. High seed proximity to isolated forest patches.
